summary: Iteration 4 - Testing 50-second video timer and USD to PKR conversion features. All backend tests passed (12/12). Frontend tests verified all new features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: (1) 50-second video timer with countdown modal, (2) USD to PKR conversion on Deposit page showing exchange rate and converted amount, (3) USD to PKR conversion on Withdraw page showing gross PKR amount and net amount after fees, (4) Admin Settings page has USD to PKR Rate field that can be configured.

video_watch_timer.details: Timer modal shows countdown from 0 to 50 seconds. Warning message displayed about losing rewards if closed early. Button shows remaining seconds (e.g., 'Wait 48 more seconds...').

deposit_page_conversion.details: Currency Conversion section shows: USD amount → @ 300 PKR → PKR equivalent. Example: $100.00 → PKR 30,000

withdraw_page_conversion.details: Currency Conversion section shows: Requested USD → @ 300 PKR → Gross PKR, then Fee (2%), then 'You'll receive: USD = PKR' after fees

admin_usd_to_pkr_rate.details: Admin Settings page under 'Withdrawal Settings' section shows 'USD to PKR Rate' input field with current value (300). Admin can update this value.
